title: Column Types, Modifiers aur Indexes
objectives: Column ko `change()` se badalna, rename aur drop karna

sections.heading: Column types
sections.body: Har column ka ek type hota hai. Sahi type chunne se data safe aur database tez rehta hai.

code.code:
Schema::create('products', function (Blueprint $table) {
    $table->id();                                  // BIGINT auto-increment primary key
    $table->string('name', 150);                   // VARCHAR(150)
    $table->string('sku')->unique();               // unique value
    $table->text('description')->nullable();       // lamba text
    $table->decimal('price', 8, 2);                // paise: 123456.78 tak
    $table->unsignedInteger('stock')->default(0);  // negative nahi
    $table->boolean('is_active')->default(true);   // true/false
    $table->date('launch_date')->nullable();       // sirf date
    $table->json('meta')->nullable();              // JSON data
    $table->softDeletes();                         // deleted_at
    $table->timestamps();                          // created_at, updated_at
});

explain: Paison ke liye `decimal` use karo, `float` nahi (rounding galtiyan).
`softDeletes()` – record delete hone par asli mein hata nahi, `deleted_at` bhar jaata hai (Eloquent module mein detail).

sections.heading: Modifiers
sections.body: Column ke baad chain karke extra rules lagate hain:

code.code:
$table->string('nickname')->nullable();          // NULL allow
$table->integer('rating')->default(5);           // default value
$table->string('email')->unique();               // duplicate nahi
$table->string('code')->index();                 // search tez
$table->string('note')->comment('Admin ka note');// comment
$table->string('slug')->after('name');           // sirf MySQL: name ke baad

sections.heading: Column badalna, rename aur drop
sections.body: Existing column badalne ke liye nayi migration mein `change()` use hota hai.

callout.text: Laravel 11 se `change()` mein jo modifiers (nullable, default...) rakhna chahte ho woh sab dobara likhne padte hain, warna woh hat jaate hain.

versionDiff.heading: Column modify: Laravel 10 vs 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Column types aur modifiers teeno versions mein same hain. Farak column badalne ke tareeke mein hai.

items.11: `change()`, `renameColumn`, `dropColumn` native hain, `doctrine/dbal` package ki zarurat nahi. `change()` mein saare modifiers dobara likho.
items.13: Same as 11. Latest column types ki list official migrations docs mein dekho.

errors.error: Column ka default ya nullable `change()` ke baad gayab ho gaya
errors.cause: `change()` mein purane modifiers dobara nahi likhe.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: UNIQUE constraint failed
errors.cause: Unique column mein duplicate value daali.
errors.fix: Unique value do, ya constraint ki zarurat dobara socho.

errors.error: Data truncated / Numeric value out of range
errors.cause: Value column ke type ki limit se badi hai (jaise `decimal(8,2)`).
errors.fix: Sahi type/size chuno (jaise `decimal(10,2)`) aur nayi migration se badlo.

debug.body: Table ka asli structure dekhne ke liye `db:table` use karo.

code.code:
php artisan db:table products
php artisan migrate --pretend

quiz.q: Paison ke liye kaunsa type best hai?
quiz.why: `decimal` exact values rakhta hai, `float` mein rounding galtiyan ho sakti hain.
Yeh `deleted_at` nullable timestamp column jodta hai.

quiz.q: Laravel 11+ mein `change()` ke saath kya yaad rakhna hai?
quiz.why: Jo modifiers rakhne hain unhe `change()` ke saath dobara likhna padta hai.

interview.a: Column mein NULL value allow karta hai.
Jab column par baar-baar filter, sort ya join hota ho. Zyada index insert/update dheema karte hain.
`index()` sirf search tez karta hai. `unique()` duplicate bhi rokta hai.

interview.q: Paise `float` mein store kyun nahi karte?
interview.a: Floating point rounding errors deta hai. `decimal` ya integer (paise mein) use karte hain.
Record permanently delete nahi hota, `deleted_at` bharta hai, to recover kar sakte ho.

summary: Sahi column type chuno: paise ke liye `decimal`.
